item.title: Local legislators and businesses come together on Manatee County Day
item.description: Manatee County commissioners travel to Tallahassee to meet with legislators annually to discuss the county’s needs and priorities.This year, residents, business owners and nonprofit leaders took a trip with them for Manatee County Day, which actually spanned two days — Feb. 4-5. item.title: FDOT prefers fixed-span design for Longboat Pass Bridge replacement
item.description: Leaving Longboat Key from the northern end will look much different in the coming years as two bridges on that route are set to be replaced.One, though — the Cortez Bridge — is a lot further along in the replacement process than the other. With construction of the new bridge connecting Bradenton Beach to Cortez set to begin this year, drivers will be traveling on a new, fixed-span bridge in no time. item.title: Sarasota wraps up two-day city manager interview process
item.description: A whirlwind two days of activity wrapped up Tuesday afternoon for the five finalist candidates for the position of Sarasota city manager. item.title: Late-night cookie chain opens its first store in Sarasota
item.description: If you ever find yourself with a midnight craving, a new expansion of a bakery chain to Sarasota may cater to your sweet tooth. Insomnia Cookies has opened its first store in Sarasota, located at 2264 Gulf Gate Drive. The bakery is open until late at night, at times ranging from 1 a.m. to 3 a.m. While it offers in-store pickup, it is also known for its late-night delivery options. item.title: Sarasota selects next city manager
item.description: Seventeen months after the retirement of Marlon Brown, Sarasota has a new city manager.Following a brief discussion on Friday, the Sarasota City Commission unanimously selected Karie Friling as the city's next top executive.
